Class CardController

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.controller.CardController
@Controller public class CardController extends Object
Controller responsible for handling card-related HTTP requests.

Provides CRUD operations for Card entities and exposes an endpoint to display all available cards in the TCG catalogue.

Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier

    • listCards

      @GetMapping("/cards") public String listCards(org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Handles GET requests to /cards and displays the full card catalogue.

      Retrieves all cards from the database and adds them to the model for rendering in the cards view.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass card data to the view
      Returns:
      the name of the view template ("cards")
